newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norzink failed to reach production target in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Norzink failed to reach production target in 1996.

text.p: Norway's Norzink AS produced about 135,000 tonnes of zinc last year, but fell short of its production target by 5,000 tonnes because of restructuring work and trouble with unions, a company spokesman said on Monday.

"We did not produce 140,000 tonnes in 1996," he said. "It was a goal we were trying for, but 1996 was a turbulent year with a lot of discussions betwseen management and unions over maintenance and restructuring plans."
Some lay-offs resulted from the restructuring at Norzink's plant in Odda on the west coast.
"But a production of 135,000 tonnes made it one of our best years," he said. "The target for 1997 is about 138,000."
The company is jointly owned by RTZ Corp Plc and Trelleborg AB.
